title: [cross-lane] ERP depends on five rs_console routes that neither contract doc lists (facebookPool.ts calls the console directly)
failure_scenario: A console change that tightens ACCOUNT_WRITE_FIELDS to match coordinator.ts, or that renames or removes /v1/workers/{id}/session or /restore-session as unused by the ERP, passes the console's suite. After deploy, every pool Assign either drops fb_uid, so the worker signs in the new account from the previous account's device identity, or falls back from cookie-first to a password Re-login, which is a Facebook login from the worker IP and the checkpoint risk the root AGENTS.md calls the first rule.
